page.layout: One column of running text; running head at the top with page number at top right; signature mark at the foot. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: sulta ad nos,&c exquisita defe-runt. Alterius vero exemplū habemus in causa Quintiana, quam Cicero defendit: ubi non modo C. Aquilius Gallus iudex sedebat, verum etiam L. Lucullum, L. Quintilium, & M. Marcellum, tres Iuriscōsultos, in consilium adhibuerat. Spartianus etiā auctor est, Adrianum imperatorem, quoties iudicio alicui praeesset, semper Iuriscō-sultos aliquot in consilio habuisse. Lampridius autē scribit, Papiniani praefecti praet. assessores fuisse Iulii Paulū, & Domitiū Ulpianū Iurisc. cuius rei exemplū extat in L. le-

page.notes: The first line ends with a small printed mark («) after "defe"; it is a printer's sign, not text, and is left out. Small dots and tick marks in the right and left margins are specks, not printed text. The word "sulta" is printed "fulta"; the long s has been read as s. Reading "Iuriscō-sultos" depends on the macron over the o, which stands for an omitted n. The last word "le-" continues on the next page.
